message: The text type can only be used as a response or response-stream, which x-fern-type cannot express; Fern treats it as unknown. Use a text/plain response instead.
The bytes type can only be used as a request, which x-fern-type cannot express; Fern treats it as unknown. Use an application/octet-stream request body instead.

The file type can only be used as properties in inlined requests, which x-fern-type cannot express; Fern treats it as unknown, so the value is no longer uploaded as a file. Use a multipart/form-data request property with type: string and format: binary instead.
